source.original_feedback_text: Your submission demonstrates a partial understanding of formal logic encoding in Lean, with some reasonable attempts at real-world scenario modelling. In Scenario 2 and Scenario 4, you provide working proofs that are logically valid, though slightly underexplained in parts. However, Scenario 1 lacks full justification your proof uses only the prerequisite disjunction and disregards the second required condition (approval), which violates the requirement to use both inputs as specified in the brief. Scenario 3 does not attempt to reach the goal statement of arrival under specified route conditions and instead builds a partial implication. Additionally, Part 2 proofs are not attempted.
